provenance.text: Canonical approved Library sample titles and explicit fixture identities. Bundled artwork manifest supplies covers; null artwork on other projects means neutral fallback. Text retains existing prototype walkthrough content.

sections.title: Chapter 1
sections.text:
The sea was quiet that morning. Mara stood at the end of the pier, holding a letter she had promised never to open.

Beyond the harbor, a single light moved through the fog. It had been there yesterday, too, and the day before.

She tucked the envelope into her coat and began to walk.

The boards were still damp with night, and each step brought her closer to a question she wasn’t sure she wanted answered.

sections.title: Beyond the harbor
sections.text: By noon the water had drawn back from the old stone steps.

The sea was quiet that morning. Mara stood at the end of the pier, holding a letter she had promised never to open.

Beyond the harbor, a single light moved through the fog. It had been there yesterday, too, and the day before.

sections.title: A map of silence
sections.text:
By morning, the rain had drawn a new coastline on the window. Mara watched the last drops gather at the edge of the glass, each one holding a smaller version of the room.
She unfolded the map on the kitchen table. There were no roads where she was going, only a pale line that followed the river north. Her father had marked the crossing in pencil.
Outside, the town was beginning to wake. Somewhere a gate closed, and the sound carried farther than it should have.
She packed the map last. Some journeys began with a destination. This one began with a question.
